dialogues.jp: コンコン、とノックの音がする。
dialogues.en: Someone was knocking on my door.
dialogues.text: Someone was knocking on my door.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、入るわよ」
dialogues.en: "Nii-san, I'm coming in."
dialogues.text: "Nii-san, I'm coming in."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Ok."
dialogues.text: "Ok."

dialogues.jp:
俺はまだ、昨日の夢から抜け切れず、上半身を
起こしてぼんやりとしていた。
dialogues.en:
I was sitting upright in bed, still haunted by last night's
dream.
dialogues.text:
I was sitting upright in bed, still haunted by last night's
dream.

dialogues.jp: 「どうかしたのか？」
dialogues.en: "What's up?"
dialogues.text: "What's up?"

dialogues.jp: 「身体の具合でも悪いのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you not feeling well?"
dialogues.text: "Are you not feeling well?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ううん。もう最近はだいぶ平気」
dialogues.en: "Nope, I've been fine recently."
dialogues.text: "Nope, I've been fine recently."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そっか。ならいいけど」
dialogues.en: "Ah, that's good."
dialogues.text: "Ah, that's good."

dialogues.jp: 音夢はたまに、無理するからな……。
dialogues.en: Nemu tends to overdo it at times...
dialogues.text: Nemu tends to overdo it at times...

dialogues.jp: 大丈夫じゃないのに、大丈夫な振りをする。
dialogues.en: Even if she's not at all fine, she'd pretend that she is.
dialogues.text: Even if she's not at all fine, she'd pretend that she is.

dialogues.jp:
兄である俺に対して、そんな遠慮は無用だと思
うのだが……音夢の性格なんだろう。
dialogues.en:
You'd think that she'd at least be honest with her
brother... but that's her character, after all.
dialogues.text:
You'd think that she'd at least be honest with her
brother... but that's her character, after all.

dialogues.jp:
あるいは、俺にだけは迷惑や心配をかけたくな
いと思っているのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
She probably just thinks that she doesn't want to be trouble
to me.
dialogues.text:
She probably just thinks that she doesn't want to be trouble
to me.

dialogues.jp:
そうやって、自分を追い込んでしまうのだ。俺
の知っている音夢は、そんな女の子だった。
dialogues.en:
And push herself to the very limit to keep herself from
showing it. That's the kind of girl she is.
dialogues.text:
And push herself to the very limit to keep herself from
showing it. That's the kind of girl she is.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、いい加減に起きないと」
dialogues.en: "Just get up already, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "Just get up already, nii-san."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、枕元にある目覚まし時計を見る。ちょう
ど１１時を回ったところだ。
dialogues.en:
I took a glance at the bedside clock. It was just past 11
AM.
dialogues.text:
I took a glance at the bedside clock. It was just past 11
AM.

dialogues.jp: 「もう、こんな時間か」
dialogues.en: "Wow, it's already this late?"
dialogues.text: "Wow, it's already this late?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「休みだからって寝てちゃだめだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Even if it's spring break, you shouldn't be such a
sleepyhead."
dialogues.text:
"Even if it's spring break, you shouldn't be such a
sleepyhead."

dialogues.jp: 優しい口調で音夢が言う。
dialogues.en: Ahh, my sister and her sweet little mouth.
dialogues.text: Ahh, my sister and her sweet little mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「もうその台詞、耳にタコだぞ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah yeah, I've heard those words a million times already."
dialogues.text: "Yeah yeah, I've heard those words a million times already."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だったら、忘れないよね？」
dialogues.en: "Then don't forget it this time."
dialogues.text: "Then don't forget it this time."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃそうさ。これまでに……」
dialogues.en: "Of course, milady. From now on..."
dialogues.text: "Of course, milady. From now on..."

dialogues.jp:
言いかけて、ふと気づいた。音夢のやつ……何
か、様子がおかしい。
dialogues.en:
Before I could go on with my nonsense, I finally noticed.
That Nemu... she's acting weird.
dialogues.text:
Before I could go on with my nonsense, I finally noticed.
That Nemu... she's acting weird.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「これからはちゃんと起きなきゃ……私が起こ
　さなくても、自分だけで……ね？」
dialogues.en:
"You'd have to wake up yourself from now on... since I
can't... you know?"
dialogues.text:
"You'd have to wake up yourself from now on... since I
can't... you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Wha huh?"
dialogues.text: "Wha huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おい？」
dialogues.en: "Hey?"
dialogues.text: "Hey?"

dialogues.jp: ……何か、嫌な予感がする。
dialogues.en: ...I have a bad feeling about this.
dialogues.text: ...I have a bad feeling about this.

dialogues.jp: 長年一緒に住んでいると何となく分かるもんだ。
dialogues.en: We've been living together for so long already.
dialogues.text: We've been living together for so long already.

dialogues.jp: 今、音夢が何かを言おうとしていて、
dialogues.en: What she was talking about just now...
dialogues.text: What she was talking about just now...

dialogues.jp:
それが、俺にとってあまり嬉しいことではない
ということが……。
dialogues.en: ...Doesn't sound like anything I'd be happy about...
dialogues.text: ...Doesn't sound like anything I'd be happy about...

dialogues.jp: 「何か、あったのか？」
dialogues.en: "Did something happen?"
dialogues.text: "Did something happen?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、音夢が自分から話しやすいように、きっ
かけを作ってやる。
dialogues.en:
She had to have something to say... so I provided an
appropriate platform.
dialogues.text:
She had to have something to say... so I provided an
appropriate platform.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん、あのね……」
dialogues.en: "Well, um..."
dialogues.text: "Well, um..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もう、兄さんを起こす人が、誰もいなくなっ
　ちゃうから」
dialogues.en:
"I meant that... there won't be anyone to wake you up
anymore..."
dialogues.text:
"I meant that... there won't be anyone to wake you up
anymore..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Ehhh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehhh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どういうことだ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……実は、私、看護学校へ行くことになった
　んだ」
dialogues.en: "...I've decided to go to nursing school."
dialogues.text: "...I've decided to go to nursing school."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「看護学校？」
dialogues.en: "Nursing school?"
dialogues.text: "Nursing school?"

dialogues.jp: 初耳だ。
dialogues.en: That's the first time I've heard of something like that...
dialogues.text: That's the first time I've heard of something like that...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だから、兄さんと本校には通えないの……」
dialogues.en: "So I won't be going with you to the main school..."
dialogues.text: "So I won't be going with you to the main school..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は、ちょっと悲しそうな顔を浮かべた。
dialogues.en: Nemu's face grew a little sad.
dialogues.text: Nemu's face grew a little sad.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「黙ってて、ごめんね」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry for not telling you earlier..."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry for not telling you earlier..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや……。ちょっと突然で驚いた」
dialogues.en: "No... it was just sudden..."
dialogues.text: "No... it was just sudden..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……うん。最近、兄さんは胡ノ宮さんのこと
　で頭いっぱいみたいだったから」
dialogues.en:
"...Yeah. Since you've been thinking so much about
Konomiya-san lately."
dialogues.text:
"...Yeah. Since you've been thinking so much about
Konomiya-san lately."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「つい、言いそびれちゃって」
dialogues.en: "I thought I wouldn't bother you more."
dialogues.text: "I thought I wouldn't bother you more."

dialogues.jp: え？
dialogues.en: Ehh?
dialogues.text: Ehh?

dialogues.jp: そんな風に見えるのか？
dialogues.en: Was that how it looked like to others?
dialogues.text: Was that how it looked like to others?

dialogues.jp:
自分ではそこまで、環について思いつめている
つもりはなかったのだが。
dialogues.en: Evne I hadn't noticed it myself...
dialogues.text: Evne I hadn't noticed it myself...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「応援、するよ……」
dialogues.en: "I'd support you two..."
dialogues.text: "I'd support you two..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は俯き加減でそう言う。
dialogues.en: Her eyes travelled down to her feet.
dialogues.text: Her eyes travelled down to her feet.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「妹として……兄さんたちのこと」
dialogues.en: "As a sister... to her brother."
dialogues.text: "As a sister... to her brother."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「二人のこと、応援するからね」
dialogues.en: "I'd support the two of you."
dialogues.text: "I'd support the two of you."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、何と答えてやっていいか、言葉が見つか
らない。
dialogues.en: I was at a loss for words.
dialogues.text: I was at a loss for words.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だからね。兄さんも、私のこと、応援して欲
　しいの」
dialogues.en: "In return... I want you to support me as well, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "In return... I want you to support me as well, nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「家を……出るのか？」
dialogues.en: "You'd be... moving out?"
dialogues.text: "You'd be... moving out?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢はゆっくりと頷く。
dialogues.en: She slowly nodded her head.
dialogues.text: She slowly nodded her head.

dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
dialogues.en: "...I see."
dialogues.text: "...I see."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「たまには帰ってくるよ」
dialogues.en: "I'd come back to visit, once in a while."
dialogues.text: "I'd come back to visit, once in a while."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いつから行くんだ？」
dialogues.en: "When are you leaving?"
dialogues.text: "When are you leaving?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今日、もう少ししたら……」
dialogues.en: "Today, in a little while..."
dialogues.text: "Today, in a little while..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Today?!"
dialogues.text: "Today?!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もう荷造りも終わってる。あとは船の時間が
　来たら、ここを出て行くだけなの」
dialogues.en:
"I've already finished packing. All I've to do left, is to
wait for the boat to arrive..."
dialogues.text:
"I've already finished packing. All I've to do left, is to
wait for the boat to arrive..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それはまた……急な話だな」
dialogues.en: "That's just so... quick."
dialogues.text: "That's just so... quick."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんね……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry..."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp: 何だか。
dialogues.en: This feeling...
dialogues.text: This feeling...

dialogues.jp: とても淋しい気持ちだ。
dialogues.en: This feeling of pure loneliness.
dialogues.text: This feeling of pure loneliness.

dialogues.jp: 妹のことを、気にしてあげられなかったこと。
dialogues.en: I didn't notice anything different about her.
dialogues.text: I didn't notice anything different about her.

dialogues.jp: 妹が、自分に相談してくれなかったこと。
dialogues.en: She didn't think of consulting me about this either.
dialogues.text: She didn't think of consulting me about this either.

dialogues.jp:
でも、それは音夢の責任じゃない。俺が音夢の
ことを気にかけなかったせいだ。
dialogues.en:
But that wasn't really her duty... it was my fault that I
didn't notice anything.
dialogues.text:
But that wasn't really her duty... it was my fault that I
didn't notice anything.

dialogues.jp:
どんなに音夢が寂しい思いをしていたのか、今
頃になって思い知らされた感じだ。
dialogues.en:
Only now, I could understand the feelings of sadness she
must've felt before.
dialogues.text:
Only now, I could understand the feelings of sadness she
must've felt before.

dialogues.jp: 結局、俺は……いつも、終わってから気づく。
dialogues.en: In the end... I'm always the last to know.
dialogues.text: In the end... I'm always the last to know.

dialogues.jp: 「……頑張れよ」
dialogues.en: "...Do your best."
dialogues.text: "...Do your best."

dialogues.jp: もう、その一言しか、俺には言えない。
dialogues.en: No other words could leave my mouth.
dialogues.text: No other words could leave my mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん。ありがと」
dialogues.en: "Mm. Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Mm. Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は笑って俺に答える。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled at my answer.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled at my answer.

dialogues.jp: 音夢は、自分の意志で、自分の道を決めたんだ。
dialogues.en: Nemu had, of her own will, decided her path.
dialogues.text: Nemu had, of her own will, decided her path.

dialogues.jp: それは、多分、誰にも止められない。
dialogues.en: Since that's the case... who am I, or anyone, to stop her.
dialogues.text: Since that's the case... who am I, or anyone, to stop her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、行くね」
dialogues.en: "I'd be going, then."
dialogues.text: "I'd be going, then."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう行くのか？」
dialogues.en: "So soon?"
dialogues.text: "So soon?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「時間だからね」
dialogues.en: "It's just about time..."
dialogues.text: "It's just about time..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そっか……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、見送りはいらないよ。兄さんにも、色々
　とやることあるだろうし……」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, don't see me off. I know you have a lot of things to
take care of, too..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, don't see me off. I know you have a lot of things to
take care of, too..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そんなこと……」
dialogues.en: "But that's..."
dialogues.text: "But that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、もう行くよ」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I'd be leaving."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I'd be leaving."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「元気でね、兄さん……」
dialogues.en: "Stay happy, nii-san..."
dialogues.text: "Stay happy, nii-san..."

dialogues.jp:
音夢が出て行く。バタンとドアが閉じる音が寂
しかった。
dialogues.en:
Nemu left the room. The bang of the door closing signalled
the start of a wave of loneliness.
dialogues.text:
Nemu left the room. The bang of the door closing signalled
the start of a wave of loneliness.

dialogues.jp: あいつ、身体は大丈夫なのか？
dialogues.en: Will she really be okay? Especially health-wise?
dialogues.text: Will she really be okay? Especially health-wise?

dialogues.jp: 無理をしなきゃいいけど……。
dialogues.en: She shouldn't be overexerting herself...
dialogues.text: She shouldn't be overexerting herself...

dialogues.jp: 音夢を見て、思った。
dialogues.en: As I watched her, that was all I thought.
dialogues.text: As I watched her, that was all I thought.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、自分がいいと思う道へ進むしかない。
dialogues.en:
In the end, she's doing her best to make progress on her
life, the way she wants.
dialogues.text:
In the end, she's doing her best to make progress on her
life, the way she wants.

dialogues.jp: 自分の未来は、自分で決めるものだ。
dialogues.en:
Your own future should be decided by no one but yourself,
after all.
dialogues.text:
Your own future should be decided by no one but yourself,
after all.

dialogues.jp: ◆看護学校へ行く音夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nemu, Off to Nursing School?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nemu, Off to Nursing School?◆

dialogues.jp: 朝、起きると音夢が部屋に入ってくる。
dialogues.en: Nemu went into my room as I woke up.
dialogues.text: Nemu went into my room as I woke up.

dialogues.jp: 学園には行かず、看護学校に進学すると言う。
dialogues.en:
She told me that she wasn't going to the main school, but to
a nursing school instead.
dialogues.text:
She told me that she wasn't going to the main school, but to
a nursing school instead.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の身体も心配だが、兄として送り出してや
ろうと思う。
dialogues.en: I sent her off mentally with well-wishes for her health.
dialogues.text: I sent her off mentally with well-wishes for her health.
